description.value: A community-focused craft brewery on Dunsmuir Avenue in the village of Cumberland, a renowned mountain biking destination in the Comox Valley. Founded in 2014, it follows a hyper-local model with no distribution outside Cumberland, so the only way to taste their house-brewed beers is to visit in person. The globally inspired food menu and outdoor dog-friendly patio make it a natural gathering spot after a day on the trails.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 13m; stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (1 space, covered) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 84m. Total: 11 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website FAQ explicitly confirms bike parking ('we have a bike rack you can hang your bike from!'). The food menu uses GFO, VO, DFO, V, DF, GF labels on multiple items, confirming dietary options. Contact details match between OSM and website (phone 250-400-BREW = 250-400-2739, address 2732 Dunsmuir Ave, email hello@cumberlandbrewing.com). Wi-Fi is tagged in OSM (internet_access=wlan) but not mentioned on the website, so left unconfirmed. No explicit mention of water refills, washrooms, takeout, charging, or pump on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established community brewery with food service, a dedicated bike rack, and an outdoor patio in Cumberland — a village synonymous with cycling. Clear fit for touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items labelled V (vegan), VO (vegan option), GF (gluten-free), GFO (gluten-free option), DF (dairy-free), DFO (dairy-free option); e.g. Coconut Red Thai Vegetable Curry is V, DF, GF
